html_source: Arnold Böcklin, Das Irrlicht, 1862, oil painting displayed in the Museum Georg Schäfer, Schweinfurt. It shows a will-o'-the-wisp leading a traveler down into a dark declivity at the close of day. Source: Wikimedia Commons.
